title: Verify the admin Fees & Discounts page needs the Settings → Finance permission
custom_preconds: 1. A ZZAUTOTEST role is assigned to Tech (exact-user-match) WITHOUT Settings → Finance.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as a role without Settings → Finance (for example Tech) and try to reach Administration → Finance → Fees & Discounts.
  2. Restore the role afterward.
custom_expected: 1. Without Settings → Finance, the admin Fees & Discounts page cannot be opened and templates cannot be created/edited/deleted.
